question.text: In case of simultaneous change of Sponsor/Manager AND change in control of Sponsor/Manager of a Cat III AIF, what is the fee payable to SEBI?

answer.text: Two separate fees of Rs. 15 lakh each
A single fee of Rs. 15 lakh

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular Nov 17, 2022, a single fee of Rs. 15 lakh is levied even when both changes occur simultaneously. **The Trap:** Two separate fees are not charged; Rs. 10 lakh is incorrect; a fee IS payable. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same rule applies to Cat I/II (XIX-A). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Plan back-to-back control changes within the same filing window to optimise the single-fee treatment.
